title: Designboom: Build your own sustainable commute
body_html:
On 26 January 2023, design magazine Designboom featured the Bamboo Bicycle Club's Bamboo Gravel Bike Build Kit — the kit that lets you build your own bicycle frame at home from bamboo poles joined with recycled-aluminium lugs.

Designboom described how the kit lets riders "take control of their commute and become a maker of their own vehicle", joining bamboo poles with recycled-aluminium lugs for a custom frame with consistent performance — and noted that the pre-made connections "speed up the build progress by 75%".

In Designboom's words:

"Promoting local manufacturing, DIY, and independence, Bamboo Bicycle Club's Bamboo Gravel
Bike Build Kit revolutionises our relationship with cycling."

"By combining the lug with bamboo, it offers a natural vibration dampening and resolves the
current bicycle market's lack of flexibility and high costs."

Read the full feature on Designboom: bamboo bicycle club lets you build your own sustainable commute

---

*Editor's note (not for publication): The previous version of this post added claims that were not in the Designboom article — a "14 million+ monthly readers / world's largest design magazine" line, a "second Designboom appearance" count, and a "70–80 hour" build figure presented as a Designboom statistic. All three were unverified or inaccurate and have been removed. The "stronger than steel" line that appears in the source article has been deliberately left out. A duplicate BBC post of the same coverage exists at `/blogs/news/designboom-build-your-own-sustainable-commute` (1 Jul 2023) and should be consolidated.*
